snippet.title: Grazed - Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
The closer you get, the stronger you get. Grazed is an incremental arcade game where to kill you have to get in range of dying. Push your kill combo high enough to ignite absurd powers and chase the highest score. Every run earns upgrades, so you always come back deadlier.

Coming to Steam November 10, 2026.

Steam Page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5058280/Grazed__Incremental_Arcade/
